author: RATTLEWARRIOR
body: so recently, i got banned on the discord, and yeah. it was for spamming moderators for an unknown cause. i just want to express my love so the moderators, or atleast some of them. i also said that there might be a hacker, so its not completely an unknown cause. i would lso like to say that a vlad was kicked for the same reason. but he only got kicked. he did just as much as i did. my "warnings", or whatever you call doing @moderator, was only like every other day, and i didnt do that very much, i also pinged the admins for a legit question. if this isnt appealable, then sorry, but for now, hi. how are you. i love you and have a good day

title: futile attempt

replies.author: Camemes
replies.body:
Heyo,
Sorry for a late response but you still pinged moderators for an illegitimate reason. Saying there might be a hacker is different to "there is a hacker, get a mod on now." 
You can express your love for the moderators privately in pms rather than pinging every single moderator which is used only if you need one. 
Vlad didn't do it as much as you so he only got kicked, you on the other hand got multiple warnings and kicks.

This appeal is denied, come back in another 2 months to try appeal again.
I also suggest not ban evading in the mean time.

Cheers,
Cammy
